rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: slide that says nothing standalone. Smallest chunk: chunk 10 'Check the text before it becomes an action' lines 58-62: 'Unsupported text becomes an unsupported action.' is a self-carrying claim. All 11 chunks carry a claim; check-slide-size --report lists 11 slides.

Harm: header the content contradicts. Closest: chunk 8 line 43 '## You have done this before' - header is a recognition claim and lines 47-50 show each method finding a gap, true to it; chunk 3 line 7 'collapses the error rate' matches lines 11-13 (10% to 0.01%).

Harm: tic visible at slide density. Greps: Not-X-Not-Y pattern `Not [^.]*\. Not ` -> 0 matches in body; no 'most useful' superlatives. Closest: chunk 11 line 68 'Drift is a warning, not proof of fabrication' - single contrast, not a triple. Chunk 3 numbers (lines 11-13) carry the label 'The numbers are illustrative' (line 15), so no number+retraction. Chunk 3 Round 1/2/3 is an enumeration with new numbers per leg. No verb triplets, no abstraction-noun stacks.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
